Prophecy: Damascus and Samaria Plundered Before the Child Speaks
ProphecySummary: Before Isaiah's son Maher-shalal-hash-baz learns to say father or mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria will be carried away before the king of Assyria.
Fulfillment: Assyria plundered Damascus in 732 BC and Samaria in 722 BC, within the child's infancy and early childhood as the sign requires.
